task.description: Diagnose GitHub issue #355 (ISS-0099): TC-SPT-01-06 fails because applyRequestStorageRouting() falls back to LEGACY_RLS/public for an unprovisioned tenant ID instead of routing to the SCHEMA path.
acceptance_criteria: Correct fix direction chosen (provision real tenant vs. weaken assertion)

result.summary: Confirmed pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting() is correct per the ISS-501 design (same class of drift as ISS-0098, sibling issue). TC-SPT-01-06's stated intent (exercise the SCHEMA routing branch) is still a valid SPT-01 acceptance criterion and is not covered by any other test (TC-SPT-01-07 covers the LEGACY_RLS/public fallback only). Chose option (a) from the issue: provision a real public.tenant row with storage_mode='SCHEMA' for the test UUID, rather than weakening the assertion to match the fallback.
